title: Second default FCB at 006Ch
rationale: Observable and useful to two-operand transients, but not explicitly universal in the manuals.
conformance impact: Activate two-operand 005Ch/006Ch comparison only for the strict CCP profile.

title: Default FCB unopened control fields
evidence reviewed: B/I: CCP and ENTRY001; I021/I027/I028
rationale: No documentary or software-dependency basis makes exact unopened scratch/control bytes portable.
conformance impact: Require filename/type parsing; accept variation in other unopened fields.

title: Leading blank in command tail
evidence reviewed: A/B/I: tail convention, CCP, ENTRY001; I021/I023/I028
rationale: The leading separator is part of the established transient command-tail interface and consequential to ordinary argument parsing.
conformance impact: Positive mixed-command test must require the leading counted blank.

title: Uppercase command-tail representation
evidence reviewed: A/B/I: CCP command acquisition and ENTRY001; I021/I023/I028
rationale: CP/M command acquisition presents canonical uppercase bytes and historical programs rely on that normalization.
conformance impact: Mixed-case acquisition test must verify uppercase tail bytes.

title: NUL after counted command tail
evidence reviewed: B/I: CCP and ENTRY001; length-counted interface evidence
rationale: The public tail is length-counted; the extra NUL is convenient DRI residue without established dependency.
conformance impact: Tests must use the count and must not require or consume a terminator.

title: Exact logical-column update rules
evidence reviewed: B: DRI BDOS; I003; I055-I059 profile analysis
rationale: Exact bookkeeping affects formatted echo but is not generic console output semantics.
conformance impact: Profile test exercises the complete character-by-character column state machine.

title: LF resets DRI logical column
evidence reviewed: B: DRI BDOS; I003
rationale: This exact DRI rule is needed only when claiming its formatted-console behavior.
conformance impact: Profile test separates LF state change from emitted LF byte.

title: CR does not reset DRI logical column
evidence reviewed: B: DRI BDOS; I003
rationale: The surprising state rule is DRI-specific, observable through later TAB/echo, and unsuitable as a universal promise.
conformance impact: Profile test emits CR then probes later column-dependent output.

title: Pending-key buffering during formatted output
evidence reviewed: B: DRI BDOS; no decisive ecosystem dependency
rationale: Timing-sensitive internal input consumption must not become portable state without stronger dependency evidence.
conformance impact: No baseline assertion about retained key or BIOS call count.

title: Ctrl-C behavior after output pause
evidence reviewed: B: DRI BDOS; deferred timing experiment
rationale: The exact timing-sensitive sequence is incompletely evidenced and cannot be promised precisely.
conformance impact: Exclude exact post-pause timing/state from certification; retain diagnostic coverage.

title: Exact function 11 ready result
evidence reviewed: A conflict: IG FFh; B/I: DRI 01h, DIO004; I027
rationale: Portable compatibility is the zero/nonzero predicate; choosing either conflicting exact nonzero value would reject valid practice.
conformance impact: Require zero when not ready and nonzero when ready; vary/accept exact nonzero.

title: Function 11 pending-byte retention
evidence reviewed: B/I: BDOS and DIO004; I027
rationale: The retained-byte mechanism is observable but lacks significant portable-software dependency.
conformance impact: Do not assert retention or exact BIOS input-call count in baseline.

title: DRI function 6 ignores retained pending byte
evidence reviewed: B/I: BDOS and DIO004; I027
rationale: This is an asymmetry of DRI's private buffering rather than the documented Function-6 contract.
conformance impact: Test Function 6's direct zero/nonzero input behavior without preconditioning on private retained state.

title: Function-1 Ctrl-P printer-echo state change
evidence reviewed: A ambiguity; B/I: BDOS and IN005
rationale: Exact Ctrl-P treatment matters for DRI console fidelity but is not unambiguous generic behavior.
conformance impact: Profile requires no toggle/no echo for Function-1 Ctrl-P.

title: Function 1 consumes function-11-retained input
evidence reviewed: B/I: IN005 plus I004 retained-state evidence
rationale: This cross-call behavior belongs with the optional DRI retained-input model.
conformance impact: Activate only with the profile; verify returned byte, echo, and BIOS call count.

title: Function 10 Ctrl-P exclusion and printer-echo toggle
evidence reviewed: B/I: BDOS and BUF006; I027
rationale: It is a stable user-visible DRI line-editor convention, but the generic buffered-input contract does not require it.
conformance impact: Profile test separately requires exclusion from data and printer-echo toggle.

title: Function 10 post-Ctrl-P echo state
evidence reviewed: B/I: BUF006 Ctrl-P/LIST
rationale: This follows the selected DRI Ctrl-P state model and should not leak into baseline.
conformance impact: Profile test verifies subsequent echo reaches LIST as selected.

title: Function 10 seven-bit input masking
evidence reviewed: B: DRI BDOS; I006/I027
rationale: Seven-bit masking is appropriate for DRI terminal fidelity, not a universal byte-input promise.
conformance impact: Profile injects high-bit bytes; baseline leaves their treatment unspecified.

title: Function 10 exact correction-display bytes
evidence reviewed: B/I: BUF006 captured display stream
rationale: Exact editing display is presentation behavior and should be promised only by a named fidelity profile.
conformance impact: Byte-exact correction transcript is profile-gated.

title: Function 10 noninitial Ctrl-C behavior
evidence reviewed: A/B tension; B: DRI BDOS
rationale: The DRI exception is valuable for fidelity but narrower than documented beginning-of-line abort behavior.
conformance impact: Profile test requires storage/display of noninitial Ctrl-C; baseline tests only documented initial Ctrl-C.

title: Unavailable-drive presentation
evidence reviewed: B/I: BDOS/BIOS error paths; I026/I030/I033/I044
rationale: Unavailable-drive interaction is provider/error-policy dependent; strict operator presentation is a selectable profile.
conformance impact: Profile injects absent drive and checks interaction/recovery; baseline requires coherent failure only.

title: Function 13 user-number preservation
evidence reviewed: B/I: I007/I026/I030/I035; cross-layer state evidence
rationale: Resetting disk state must not silently change the active user namespace; preservation is consequential and stable.
conformance impact: Set nonzero user, call Function 13, require the same Function-32 result.

title: Failed-open FCB residual bytes
rationale: Only the documented failure result is portable; exact FCB residue after failure is not.
conformance impact: Poison/snapshot diagnostically, but assert only documented effects.

title: Exact EOF code
evidence reviewed: A: nonzero; B/I: DRI 01h; I027/I030
rationale: Applications must test nonzero; exact 01h has no demonstrated need sufficient to narrow the documented contract.
conformance impact: Require nonzero EOF and accept any nonzero value not otherwise promised.

title: Physical read-error presentation
rationale: The physical-error operator path is documented, while headless alternatives require explicit selection.
conformance impact: Profile injects read fault and checks prompt, ignore, abort, and recovery; no invented file code.

title: Exact write failure codes
evidence reviewed: A table commentary; B/I: directory-full=01, allocation-full=02; I030/I031
rationale: The distinction is stable, cheaply testable, and useful to applications diagnosing directory versus data exhaustion.
conformance impact: Exhaust directory and allocation separately; require 01h and 02h.

title: Physical write-error presentation
rationale: Physical write failures must remain distinct from logical full-disk codes; exact interaction belongs to the strict operator profile.
conformance impact: Profile injects pre/post-transfer write faults and checks operator path without rollback assumptions.

title: Wildcard Rename
evidence reviewed: B/I: DRI wildcard behavior; A silence; I029/I031
applicability/profile: No generic or supported profile claim
rationale: Literal destination '?' expansion is undocumented, hazardous, and unsupported by significant dependency evidence.
conformance impact: Certification rejects any claim that generic CP/M promises wildcard Rename; ordinary unambiguous Rename remains required.

title: Delete/Rename physical errors
rationale: Controller failures use the common physical-error boundary, not new 19/23 return codes.
conformance impact: Profile fault-injects directory operations and checks common operator/recovery behavior.

title: Allocation-full exact code
evidence reviewed: A table commentary; B/I: DRI 02h; I030
rationale: This is the random-write counterpart of the useful sequential-write full-allocation distinction.
conformance impact: Exhaust blocks during random write and require 02h.

title: Physical random-I/O errors
rationale: Random calls share the documented physical operator boundary; exact interaction is profile-qualified.
conformance impact: Profile injects random read/write faults separately from logical random codes.

title: Fatal presentation
evidence reviewed: B/I: protection fatal handler; I033/I044
rationale: Nonreturning operator presentation and restart are fidelity behavior; structured/headless handling may be selected separately.
conformance impact: Profile verifies nonreturn, response handling, restart, and subsequent usable service.

title: Exact diagnostic text
evidence reviewed: B/I: File R/O and R/O captured diagnostics
rationale: Byte-exact vendor text is not baseline semantics but can be promised by a fidelity profile.
conformance impact: Exact capitalization/spacing tests activate only for the diagnostic profile.

title: Automatic media-change protection
evidence reviewed: A/B: interface and BDOS source; no forced experiment
rationale: Detection depends on media/controller facilities and cannot be generic across systems.
conformance impact: A declared removable-media profile must supply deterministic change detection/protection tests.

title: Exact Bad Sector text
evidence reviewed: A/B/I: guides, DRI, I015/I033/I044/I066
rationale: Semantic Bad Sector presentation is required elsewhere; exact bytes are fidelity-profile material.
conformance impact: Profile performs byte-exact comparison; baseline checks semantic operator path.

title: Accepted ignore characters
evidence reviewed: A: carriage return; B/I: any non-Ctrl-C
rationale: Baseline promises the documented carriage-return choice; acceptance of other characters is an incidental DRI extension.
conformance impact: Require CR ignore and Ctrl-C abort; do not certify other key acceptance.

title: Structured physical-error extension
evidence reviewed: D: I015/I044/I058 extension boundary
rationale: A distinct opt-in structured API can coexist with strict CP/M presentation but is not CP/M 2.2 compatibility.
conformance impact: Extension tests must prove opt-in isolation and unchanged baseline/profile behavior.

title: Function 37 compatibility status
evidence reviewed: B/I: DRI BDOS and vectors; A silence; I026/I030
rationale: The call is real and testable but absent from examined application manuals and lacks ecosystem dependency sufficient for baseline.
conformance impact: If selected, activate the full state-effect suite; otherwise return/out-of-range policy remains as declared.

title: Active IOBYTE routing policy
evidence reviewed: A: AG explicitly optional; B/I: I018/I039
rationale: Active routing is required only when the configured BIOS/device claim advertises it.
conformance impact: Profile declares inert or active mapping and tests every selected logical-to-physical route.

title: LISTST result policy
evidence reviewed: A/B conflict: AG prose/comments and BIOS implementations; I020
rationale: LISTST exists universally, but exact status encoding and absent-device policy belong to the configured BIOS/device contract.
conformance impact: Profile defines ready/not-ready encodings and tests both states; generic callers cannot assume one exact nonzero.

title: CCP prompt presentation freedom
evidence reviewed: A silence beyond drive/readiness; B/I: DRI prompt
rationale: The drive-plus-> semantic prompt is required elsewhere; exact surrounding bytes and decoration remain implementation freedom.
conformance impact: Baseline uses semantic recognition, never byte-exact prompt decoration.

title: DRI CCP command capacity
evidence reviewed: A tension: general 255 wording; B/I: DRI 127; I023/I028
rationale: Exact acquisition capacity is a CCP implementation/profile property; the DRI limit matters only to a strict reference claim.
conformance impact: Profile tests the 127-byte boundary and rejection; baseline publishes its supported documented capacity.

title: TAB is not CCP SPACE
evidence reviewed: B/I: CCP parser and deterministic TAB cases; I024/I028
rationale: Treating TAB as whitespace silently changes command tokens and scripts; byte-compatible parsing should retain the established distinction.
conformance impact: Submit SPACE and TAB separately; require TAB not to act as token-separating SPACE.

title: Exact DRI command-error presentation
evidence reviewed: B/I: CCP comerr and corpus; A silence
rationale: Semantic rejection/recovery is baseline; offending-token text and CR/LF placement are presentation fidelity.
conformance impact: Profile compares exact error transcript; baseline verifies rejection and reprompt only.

title: Default FCB operand assignment
evidence reviewed: A/B/I: first FCB documented; second DRI prefix; I028
rationale: This is the later consolidated form of 0012 and must receive the same applicability.
conformance impact: One profile test jointly covers 0012 and 0506 without counting duplicate obligations.

title: Tail capacity is bounded by CCP input acquisition
rationale: Capacity depends on the selected command-acquisition profile, while count/tail semantics remain baseline.
conformance impact: Each CCP profile publishes and tests its accepted-line and resulting-tail limits.

title: Post-termination drive and user policy
rationale: Usable coherent return is baseline, but exact saved-drive/user persistence varies with CCP/WBOOT policy and must be declared.
conformance impact: Profile tests RET, Function 0, and JMP 0000h with changed drive/user state.

title: Function 37 state-effect profile scope
evidence reviewed: B/I: Function-37 vector effects; explicit 0435 cross-reference
rationale: This is the conditional detail of optional entry 0435, not a second baseline decision.
conformance impact: Selecting 0435 activates 0523's inactive/current/multiple/read-only vector tests.

title: Exact resident output presentation
evidence reviewed: B/I: CCP DIR/resident output; A semantic only; I047 corpus
rationale: Exact DIR layout and diagnostics are useful only for scripts or users selecting DRI presentation fidelity.
conformance impact: Profile corpus-tests exact layout/text; baseline tests semantic file listing and command result.
